GlobalPolicy.source-of-truth: Verify the canonical chain media_item -> collection/inbox -> immutable selection -> analysis_run -> artifacts.
GlobalPolicy.owner-scope: Every verification must include same-owner success and cross-owner denial where the surface reads or mutates durable state.
GlobalPolicy.diagnostics-policy: Rejected and partially processed records must produce stable diagnostics instead of disappearing.
GlobalPolicy.retention-policy: Retention checks must prove metadata, source bodies, artifacts, diagnostics, and selection snapshots follow their separate lifecycle rules.
GlobalPolicy.coverage-policy: Coverage closure is reported per surface with the metric each tool can actually emit; missing metrics remain explicit gaps and do not collapse into a fake repo-wide 100% claim.
GlobalPolicy.redaction: Never assert on raw secrets, raw bot tokens, private object URLs, or full prompt payloads.

required.item: OpenAPI validates media_item, source, collection, inbox, selection, analysis_run, artifact, diagnostic, owner, lifecycle, retention, pagination, idempotency, and error envelopes.
Schema tests fail if public contracts expose old product route vocabulary or grouped-submission concepts.
Enum tests cover media_item, collection, selection, analysis_run, and artifact statuses.
Diagnostic code tests cover ingestion rejection, owner mismatch, invalid selection, unavailable source, worker failure, artifact expiry, retention denial, and adapter conflict.
Create media_item from text, URL, and uploaded body with owner scope and source metadata.
Default inbox membership is created for accepted media_item records.
Adding media to an existing inbox or user collection appends after the current highest active position without duplicate active positions.
Collection add, remove, reorder, archive, restore, and delete use version checks.
Selection snapshot remains unchanged after collection membership and media_item metadata changes.
analysis_run creation requires a sealed selection owned by the caller.
Artifact rows link to owner and analysis_run and enforce retention status.
Diagnostics are persisted for invalid media, invalid selection, worker error, artifact error, and retention action.
Cross-owner reads and mutations fail for every table family.
Create and list media_item records across supported input kinds.
Read inbox and user collections with pagination and diagnostics summary.
Create, mutate, archive, restore, and delete collections.
Create sealed selections from ordered media_item references and option snapshots.
Create analysis_run from selection with idempotency behavior.
Poll analysis_run events and diagnostics.
Cancel analysis_run cooperatively, including queued terminal cancel, claimed cancel_requested, worker cancel-check visibility, and late worker finalization resolving as canceled.
Resolve artifact preview and download metadata through owner-scoped API access.
Query diagnostics by subject, severity, code, and correlation id.
Empty collection and paginated list results encode items as [] rather than null.
Worker claim loads sealed selection material through internal control-plane contracts.
Per-item execution diagnostics are recorded without mutating the selection snapshot.
Successful execution publishes artifacts under analysis_run.
Partial execution can finish as partially_succeeded when policy allows and diagnostics explain the skipped or failed items.
Worker cancellation records the phase where cancellation was observed.

Telegram.item: Accepted message, file, URL, photo, image, voice, audio, video, and document inputs call add_media and update inbox state.
Inline actions manage API-owned inbox or collection items, create selections, start analysis_run records, view diagnostics, and fetch artifacts.

Focused queued or running analysis_run cards expose cancellation through a run id and version checked callback, unfocused cards can cancel the latest visible active run, and background active runs do not block starting a new current selection.
Inbox visible items, remove actions, and clear-visible actions follow collection membership rather than the owner-wide media list.
Status text and inline action labels are Russian-first and make refresh, collection actions, and run-specific result buttons self-explanatory.
Callbacks use API ids and versions and cannot mutate another owner state.
No user-facing execution mode is required to accumulate multiple items.

Web.item: Inbox, collection, selection builder, run list, run detail, artifact, diagnostics, and retention views use the same public API contract.
Collection edits after run creation do not change the run detail selection snapshot.

MCP.item: Tools add_media, list_media, create_collection, update_collection_items, create_selection, run_analysis, get_run, list_artifacts, and get_diagnostics share API behavior with Web and Telegram.

required.item: Compose smoke ingests at least one file or URL, shows it in inbox, seals a selection, creates analysis_run, publishes artifacts, and exposes diagnostics.
Runtime owner isolation check proves another owner cannot read the media_item, selection, run, artifact, or diagnostics.
Retention smoke expires or soft-deletes an artifact without corrupting selection or run history.

Gate.description: GRACE docs define only final inbox-first architecture.
Gate.required-evidence: XML parsing succeeds for requirements, technology, development-plan, verification-plan, knowledge-graph, and operational-packets.

Gate.description: Stale public product vocabulary is absent from active GRACE docs.
Gate.required-evidence: Focused repository searches across the six GRACE XML files show no unacceptable active old product route, grouped-submission, public source grouping, immediate execution target, or dual-path wording.

Gate.description: Public API and schemas match canonical vocabulary.
Gate.required-evidence: Contract tests validate canonical DTOs and fail on removed public product surfaces.

Gate.description: Storage implements owner scope, immutable selection, lifecycle, retention, and diagnostics.
Gate.required-evidence: Focused storage tests pass with same-owner and cross-owner cases.

Gate.description: API provides the complete media_item to artifact flow.
Gate.required-evidence: Focused API tests pass for ingestion, inbox, collections, selection, analysis_run, cancellation, artifacts, diagnostics, and retention.

Gate.description: Telegram, Web, and MCP are thin adapters over shared API state.
Gate.required-evidence: Adapter tests prove shared state behavior and absence of separate durable adapter product state.

Gate.description: Executable coverage inventory reports the current per-surface baseline honestly.
Gate.required-evidence: `bash infra/scripts/coverage-inventory.sh` records statement, line, branch, or function coverage where supported, records pass/fail-only surfaces separately, and returns non-zero while any declared surface still has an unwired metric or failing probe.
Compose proof captures ingestion, selection, run, artifact, diagnostics, owner denial, and retention behavior.

FailureTaxonomy.failure: Input is unsupported, unreadable, too large, unsafe, or missing required metadata.
Caller attempts to read or mutate another owner resource.
Mutable collection operation used a stale version.
Selection references unavailable, deleted, quarantined, or cross-owner media_item records.
analysis_run creation was attempted from an unsealed selection.
Run cannot access a required source body because retention, deletion, or remote resolution removed it.
Internal execution failed and produced diagnostic context.
Artifact is failed, expired, deleted, or not yet published.
Retention action violates audit, owner, or lifecycle rules.

BeadsVerificationSequence.bead: Validate GRACE XML and stale vocabulary searches only.
Run storage and API orchestration checks.
